reason: no_reward - Paradex Bridge on Ethereum is a StarkWare StarkGate v2 escrow pair (USDC + ETH) whose only public value-moving function is withdraw(token,amount,recipient); it is gated only by a consumable L2->L1 message, not by a role, but it always pays the message's recipient, never the caller, so a stranger who calls pays gas and delivers someone else's money. Nothing else callable by anyone pays: deposits charge the caller a fee, the rest is owner/role admin. No claim/reward/distribute/auction function exists in either implementation's ABI.
